attchmntText: SWELECT Energy Systems Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication of the Unaudited Financial Results of the Company for the Quarter and Six months ended 30.09.2026
voiceSummary: Swelect Energy Systems Limited submitted newspaper clippings confirming the publication of its unaudited financial results for the quarter and six months ended 30.09.2026. The results were approved at a Board Meeting held on 13.11.2026. Publications appeared in Business Line and The Hindu Tamil Thisai on 15.11.2026. The company requests the exchange to take this compliance on record.

attchmntText: SWELECT Energy Systems Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 14, 2026, titled "SWELECT Reports Q2 FY27 Consolidated PAT of INR 196.19 Lakhs".
voiceSummary: SWELECT Energy Systems Limited filed a press release on 14th November 2026 regarding its Q2 FY27 financial results. The Board approved standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Consolidated Profit After Tax was reported at INR 196.19 Lakhs. Standalone Profit After Tax was INR 852.41 Lakhs. The company secured two large EPC orders of 200 MW each in Maharashtra and Rajasthan, with a combined value of approximately INR 1,400 crore. Land handover is expected this quarter. Consolidated performance was impacted by low utilization of module manufacturing lines. The company has a module order pipeline of 750 MW. Additional Power Purchase Agreements for 200 MW were signed. Nearly 217 MW of new IPP projects are under construction. The company launched its SWEES brand of hybrid inverters with BESS.

attchmntText: Swelect Energy Systems Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: SWELECT Energy Systems Limited approved Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and six months ended 30 September 2026. Standalone net profit for the quarter was Rs. 1,460.13 lakhs with basic EPS of Rs. 5.62. For the six months, standalone net profit was Rs. 2,225.52 lakhs with basic EPS of Rs. 12.32. The Board also approved the SWELECT ESOP Scheme 2026 for the grant of 75,794 options to eligible employees. This scheme is subject to shareholder approval. A Postal Ballot Notice will be issued to shareholders for approval of the ESOP Scheme and related party transactions with subsidiary companies for solar power projects. The results are available on the company website and stock exchange platforms.

attchmntText: The Board of Directors have considered and approved the Postal Ballot Notice (through remote e-voting) to seek the approval of the members of the Company for undertaking related party transactions with the subsidiary companies for solar power projects and SWELECT ESOP Scheme 2026
